scope: Local source inspection only; not a test, deployment, package-approval, or live-behavior receipt.

classificationDefinitions.implemented: The source inspected contains the core behavior stated by this backlog item. This does not imply release or validation beyond the cited code.
classificationDefinitions.applicable: Relevant source behavior exists, but the stated implementation, integration, or validation remains incomplete.
classificationDefinitions.data-limited: The requested behavior depends on evidence that the inspected source does not have or explicitly gates as unavailable.
classificationDefinitions.rejected-current-formulation: The item's current formulation conflicts with a source contract or evidence boundary and should not be implemented as stated.
classificationDefinitions.unknown: The bounded inspection did not establish whether the behavior exists or applies.

items.title: Expected wins from the actual score sampler
items.disposition: Season samplers return score-distribution win probability, include overtime, and leave expected wins unavailable when probability coverage is incomplete. The backlog's separate calibration-receipt gate still needs evaluation evidence.

items.title: Chemistry points-per-100 scale check
items.disposition: Chemistry checks matching units, computes points per 100 from numerator and denominator, and derives net from offense minus defense.

items.title: Count-derived true shooting above 100%
items.disposition: The count-based TS formula is available, but the Composite count-backed rate adapter rejects values above 1.0; valid over-100% results are not yet preserved end to end.

items.title: One Franchise defense direction
items.disposition: Franchise code names defensive-strength conventions and reconciles net as offense minus defense, but the requested exact-season refit and held-out game-outcome evidence remain separate work.

items.title: Season Lab player-row scope filter
items.disposition: Exact Season Lab package selection validates exact-season scope and required artifacts rather than substituting a pooled package; player logs are labeled allocations.

items.title: Composite missing-donor and normalization handling
items.disposition: Missing donors retain requested weight and withhold the affected value; unavailable exact-season normalization does not silently replace the requested recipe.

items.title: Unclipped optimizer objective gaps
items.disposition: The optimizer retains raw objective values for solving and reports bounded presentation scores separately.

items.title: Version scoring-event construction
items.disposition: Season Lab names its bounded native scoring construction separately from the Game Lab outcome layer, but the same exact-season holdout comparison of distribution means and tails is not established.

items.title: Score tails only from retained possession outcomes
items.disposition: Game Lab uses and discloses a bounded 0–3-point event profile when retained possession outcomes are unavailable; it does not claim observed rare-score tails.

items.title: Reduce Monte Carlo noise
items.disposition: Game Lab evaluation adapts trial counts to a standard-error target and safety limits, and emits trials, seed, and uncertainty fields.

items.title: Chronological in-season Game Lab evaluation
items.disposition: The Game Lab source identifies absent game-level pregame snapshots and limits evaluation to completed full-season holdouts; in-season as-of scoring remains unavailable.

items.title: Coverage-shrink Four-Factor corrections
items.disposition: Season Lab factor adjustments use coverage-aware shrinkage, exact-season baseline imputation, and missing-factor quality metadata.

items.title: Ablate overlapping Franchise team signals
items.disposition: Native team rates and Four-Factor signals enter Franchise strength, but no accepted exact-season ablation receipt for their incremental value was located.

items.title: Forecast-safe, venue-aware playoffs
items.disposition: Season Lab distinguishes retrospective exact-playoff evidence from forecast-safe regular-season rates and uses a higher-seed 2-2-1-1-1 venue schedule. Forecast capability remains manifest-gated.

items.title: Coherent latent team strength across regular season and playoffs
items.disposition: Regular and playoff evidence phases currently construct separate latent draws; a shared coherent team-strength draw remains to be implemented or validated.

items.title: Play-in and season-specific tiebreak rules
items.disposition: Generated play-in brackets are rejected, while the current native bracket and tie behavior are generic rather than a full season-specific play-in/tiebreak sequence.

items.title: Consistent overtime completion
items.disposition: A shared overtime-completion helper exists, but its module states consumer behavior changes only when callers are explicitly wired to it.

items.title: Separate player allocations from simulated team outcomes
items.disposition: Season Lab deterministically allocates team totals into player logs and labels those rows as modeled allocations rather than observed game logs.

items.title: Separate preference scores from team value
items.disposition: Lineup Lab separates the solver objective and display score and states that the additive impact estimate is not a game forecast or predicted coaching rotation.

items.title: Joint uncertainty and probabilistic constraints
items.disposition: The optimizer has per-input downside sensitivities, but the accepted player-game vectors and coefficient uncertainty needed for joint uncertainty and probabilistic constraints were not found in its exact-season source package.

items.title: Stint-realistic rotations and minute contract
items.disposition: Lineup Lab enforces rotation/minute feasibility, but the inspected inputs provide position labels and season exposure rather than historical stint, substitution, availability, or overtime records.

items.title: Soft position-minute targets
items.disposition: Position-minute anchors are treated as source-listed estimates with explicit soft ranges, not exact historical assignments.

items.title: Role bonuses as explanation or constraint
items.disposition: Role fit is explanatory by default; when enabled, the bounded bonus and its objective delta are reported explicitly.

items.title: Label optimizer constraints by grain
items.disposition: Current receipts identify player, selected-group, and rotation-minute constraint grain. Full-team residual constraints remain unavailable without paired team-game evidence.

items.title: Repair opponent-plan denominators and split style from defense
items.disposition: Opponent planning uses complete-stat per-100 estimates when available, otherwise labels a per-game fallback; disclosures say the response proxy is not a defensive-efficiency measure.

items.title: Expose contributions and reduce double counting
items.disposition: Ranked alternatives expose metric and family contributions, reconciliation residuals, and separate group-only/minute adjustments.

items.title: Generate meaningfully different alternatives
items.disposition: The worker supports multiple scalar scenario configurations and top alternatives, but separate downside-risk and roster-diversity alternatives are not established.

items.title: Tie-aware challenge ranks and uncertainty
items.disposition: Daily challenge result code validates complete rank/option-count proofs and reports bounded rank scope, but does not provide tie-aware uncertainty intervals for ranks.

items.title: Keep impact, lineup, exact-five scopes distinct
items.disposition: Exact-five and lineup evidence have separate required artifacts/capability gates; Chemistry and Composite describe observational or synthetic outputs without causal/forecast claims.

items.title: Reconcile box-count identities at adapter boundaries
items.disposition: The native Composite adapter checks count-identity errors and rejects non-reconciled player box-count rows.

items.title: One Composite donor per player-season
items.disposition: Composite keys profiles by player-season reference and rejects duplicate player-season identities before use.

items.title: Carry source limitations through Composite transformations
items.disposition: Composite donor transformations preserve source status/reason and surface limited-sample caveats.

items.title: Bind synthetic profile ID to its stat line
items.disposition: Composite profile fingerprints include model/recipe version, package, cohort, component values, weights, archetype, and normalization inputs.

items.title: Separate placement and simulation seeds
items.disposition: Composite placement seeds are distinct from simulation seeds; simulation is unavailable unless an explicit approved runner is supplied.

items.title: Sort Chemistry by the displayed evidence source
items.disposition: Chemistry roster values, sort values, and comparisons are sourced from the selected exact-season package.

items.title: Show Chemistry exposure with headline rates
items.disposition: Chemistry metric evidence and support displays carry numerator, denominator, and observed exposure alongside rate values.

items.title: Keep Chemistry and Composite descriptive pending outcome validation
items.disposition: Chemistry labels observed differences descriptive and non-causal; Composite labels synthetic profiles as scenarios rather than forecasts.

items.title: Trade-evidence as-of cutoff
items.disposition: Trade evaluation requires an explicit transaction instant and injected, source-pinned eligibility/deadline policy; missing cutoff or policy evidence makes the result unavailable.

items.title: Deterministic Franchise roster evidence
items.disposition: Exact-season roster rows are preferred, duplicate player refs are removed, and trimming/order are stable; source-as-of ownership semantics still depend on the supplied roster snapshot.

items.title: Season-indexed contracts and cap-state gates
items.disposition: Contract terms and cap history are keyed by season and source; incomplete, imputed, or scenario-only values are excluded or disclosed in observed commitment summaries.

items.title: Explicit draft pool, rights ledger, and qualified lottery output
items.disposition: Draft-rights completeness is source/as-of gated and lottery policies are versioned, but no accepted season-specific prospect pool evidence was found; 2030+ lottery rules are unavailable.

items.title: Enforce feasible Franchise roster transitions
items.disposition: CPU roster management signs free agents toward its target when the pool permits, but if the pool is exhausted the code can leave the team below target without a dedicated blocked-transition receipt.

items.title: Use schedule rest gaps for fatigue, no inferred travel
items.disposition: Team fatigue currently updates by a fixed per-game recurrence; no rest-gap feature is consumed by that update. The model does not infer travel from the inspected path.

items.title: Player-cluster Career transition support
items.disposition: Career transition blocks are built from adjacent seasons, but a player-clustered resampling/uncertainty receipt was not found.

items.title: Do not infer transitions across missing career seasons
items.disposition: Career transition-block construction only links contiguous season records and does not bridge a missing season.

items.title: Contiguous-block observed Career replay
items.disposition: Observed career replay exists, and contiguous season blocks are available as a building block; an observed contiguous-block bootstrap/replay path was not established.

items.title: Joint censored forward Career model only with outcome labels
items.disposition: The source has career-state evidence gates, but no sufficiently complete longitudinal availability/retirement outcome labels were found to support a joint censored forward model.

items.title: Phase-consistent Career and denominator-aware shooting
items.disposition: Career is a separate consumer with phase/count evidence paths, but complete reconciled shooting-denominator coverage and separate regular/all-phase outputs are not established for every accepted profile.

items.title: Integrate and continue calibrating DJHC ratings from observed 2K baselines
items.disposition: Versioned DJHC ratings and a one-edition holdout diagnostic exist, but the plan's multi-edition chronological calibration and separately requested complete 2025–26 list remain outstanding in this source pass.
